scope: Independent implementation of the previously declared saved TRAIN arithmetic; no selection of metrics, candidate or objective from the diagnosis outcome.

allowed_inputs: Only the same41 main-card bindings and their exact explicit tensor fields.37 TRAIN archives and4 summary JSON objects; summaries are parsed whole but only train key used.15 preservation-only files and broad before receipt are hashed only.
scope_checks: Four model/stage full-context TRAIN112 coordinate moments, ranges, correlations and population covariance trace/Frobenius/participation ratio
All saved three-repetition TRAIN predictions, exact target/row/group/support and D36 seeds; scores and fixed early56/late56 halves

First8 detailed TRAIN query masks/timestamps/support and per-cell/per-channel hierarchical MAE/GaussianNLL;27 feature panels, fixed distributions and all112 TRAIN summary reductions
All local change4 mean-NLL/MAE/Huber1 and hypothetical variance adjoints, applied V3/V4 variance policy, live conditional variance-head adjoints; norm/dot/cosines

finite_difference_contract.mean_step: h=min(1e-6*max(1,abs(error)),0.25*abs(error)) for nonzero error; h=1e-6 at zero
finite_difference_contract.variance_step: h=1e-5*variance; both perturbed variances stay positive
finite_difference_contract.limits: Scalar likelihood kernels plus independently reconstructed linear chain rules; no encoder or optimizer Jacobian replay.

saved_arithmetic_tolerance: absolute1e-10+relative1e-9 as main prospective card; exact masks/IDs/pairing/field selectors
failure_policy: Preserve failed source/card/stdout/output and use additive audit-only corrections if necessary. Never change main diagnosis or replay models/heads.
